text:
natalie: Heads up — BlueFreight just flagged an airline corridor capacity squeeze FRA->AMS for next Tue-Thu, looks like two AWBs may slip. ETA +3 days if we don't rebook. Anyone have spare EU pool units to cover a temporary loaner? :thinking:
sam: Which AWBs are we talking about? Can we try reroute via CDG or BRU instead of holding at FRA?
natalie: AWB 987-6543210 and AWB 987-6543211. Both contain 4x H100-ish blades. Forwarder suggests split shipment to CDG but that adds customs reclassification risk.
jordan: If we split, will depot acceptance at CDG align with our serial reconciliation windows? Need photo evidence for insurance.
leo: Quick cost flag — reroute + split will add a one-off surcharge. BlueFreight quoted EUR 450 per AWB for rebook + handling. Also FX note: vendor billing in USD last month, this month invoices will show EUR (we're ~1.08 USD/EUR this week). That impacts the procurement PO.
diana: Can ops pre-stage the CDG depot? If we need to swap, we want the depot to be ready to accept and run serial reconciliation. I can task depot-team but need concrete ETA window.
ops-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-5421 (vendor: BlueFreight) — status: triage, assignee: leo. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RMA-5421
forwarder-bf: BlueFreight (forwarder-bf): Confirmed — we can split AWB 987-6543210 to CDG (arrival +1 day) and push remainder to AMS (arrival +3 days). We can also provide 2 temporary loaner cards staged at CDG pending serial match. Surcharge: EUR 450 per AWB for split + EUR 800 for loaner handling.
leo: Noted. Given customer SLAs in EU, we should accept the CDG split and loaner plan. Approve up to EUR 1,500 total for expedite (covers both AWBs + loaner handling). Please route invoices to procurement-eu. :white_check_mark:
sam: Before we rebook, run quick alloc-check to ensure we're not overcommitting warm spares. Example command:```bash
./alloc-check --region eu --min-spares 2 --model h100
```
Sample output we expect: ```
region eu: available_spares=3
region eu: in-transit=6
```
If available_spares >=2 then proceed.
diana: Ran the alloc-check against staging yesterday, output looked like that. I'll re-run now and paste results.
diana: alloc-check: region eu: available_spares=2, in-transit=6, reserved_dedicated=10. We have exactly 2 free — OK to use loaners but that will drain buffer. :warning:
jordan: If loaners drain the buffer, we should set a replenishment watch and bump priority for the next auction window. Also confirm firmware compatibility before swapping to avoid DOA/return churn.
forwarder-bf: Understood — we've scheduled a CDG pre-inspect. We'll send depot photos on arrival and hold units under RMA-5421 until serials validate.
ops-bot: Note: invoice tag required: procurement-eu. Add comment to RMA-5421 with AWB updates.
natalie: I'll approve the EUR 1,500 expedite charge now and mark RMA-5421 as approved-for-expedite. Sam/Leo, please coordinate rebook and update the thread when AWBs are reissued.
leo: Will do. Rebook attempt scheduled in next 2 hours. I'll post AWB numbers when confirmed.
sam: Thanks — also loop in finance if FX fluctuation pushes us >$1,700 USD so we can get second sign-off.
natalie: Copy. Closing loop for now — thanks everyone. I'll update RMA-5421 after AWB confirmation. :memo:
